global_memory_summary.critical_distinction: NEVER treat total system RAM (140-156 GB) as homogeneous GPU VRAM. Only L1 (24GB M4 Pro), L5 (16GB M4 Air), and L1b (16GB M2 Pro) have high-bandwidth Apple Silicon Unified Metal VRAM (120-273 GB/s). L2 has 4GB discrete GDDR6 VRAM + 16GB DDR4 normal RAM. L3 (16GB DDR4 Ryzen 7 5700U), L8 (32GB DDR4 Intel i7-8700B), L4 (8GB Tablet), and L7 (12GB LPDDR5 S20+) have ZERO dedicated GPU VRAM (0 GB VRAM) and execute GGML_BACKEND_CPU over system RAM.

glances_rest_rules.rationale: Polling /api/3/all on L3 walked every PID in /proc and Docker container every 2s, consuming 449.3 MB RAM + 160.9 MB swap and blocking HTTP responses for 6.91s. Disabling heavy plugins and polling /quicklook + /mem + /load reduced L3 Glances RAM to 43.7 MB (-90.3%) and response latency to 73-82 ms (-98.8%).

polling_intervals.high_frequency_biometrics_dsp: Teleplot UDP ASCII (>metric:val@ts\n, 6.0 us P50, 30 bytes/sample)

adaptive_overload_circuit_breaker.action: Multiply poll interval by 3x, skip /network and /fs sub-queries, and reserve 1+ physical CPU core for OS/SSH/Glances.

CLASS_1_APPLE_UNIFIED_METAL_VRAM.description: Apple Silicon LPDDR5X Unified Memory shared zero-copy between CPU, Metal GPU, and 16-core ANE (120-273 GB/s).
CLASS_1_APPLE_UNIFIED_METAL_VRAM.optimization_policy: Set -ngl 99 (full Metal offload), FlashAttention enabled (-fa), mmap=true, mlock=false, keep 4-5 GB OS sanctuary reserve.

CLASS_2_DISCRETE_VRAM_PLUS_NORMAL_RAM.description: 4 GB discrete AMD Radeon Pro 5300M GDDR6 (192 GB/s) + 16 GB DDR4 Normal System RAM (38.4 GB/s) across PCIe 3.0.
CLASS_2_DISCRETE_VRAM_PLUS_NORMAL_RAM.optimization_policy: Cap Metal GPU offload strictly to <= 3.2 GB (-ngl 12..16); place remaining assigned layers or KV cache in DDR4 Normal RAM via AVX2 CPU threads (max 6 threads).

CLASS_3_NORMAL_RAM_ONLY_ZERO_VRAM.description: Standard DDR4/LPDDR5 system RAM with 0 GB dedicated GPU VRAM (iGPU shares small BIOS aperture only; no CUDA/Metal compute).
CLASS_3_NORMAL_RAM_ONLY_ZERO_VRAM.optimization_policy: Set -ngl 0 (CPU-only GGML_BACKEND_CPU AVX2/NEON). Cap threads to physical_cores - 1 (L3: 7 threads, L8: 5-10 threads, L7: 4 threads). Enforce quantized KV cache (-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0), mmap=true, mlock=false. Assign sparse MoE experts, speculative draft heads, EmbeddingGemma 2 MRL, Neo4j graph, or disaggregated KV-cache storage rather than heavy dense decode blocks.

CLASS_4_EDGE_NPU_LPDDR5X.description: 16 GB LPDDR5X unified mobile memory with Tensor G5 TPU + Mali GPU + 10.5 GB AVF Debian microVM.
CLASS_4_EDGE_NPU_LPDDR5X.optimization_policy: Use LiteRT / MediaPipe / NEON i8mm kernels with MRL 256d/512d truncation and speculative draft heads.

L8.cpu_model: Intel Core i7-8700B @ 3.20GHz (6C/12T, Intel UHD 630 iGPU)
